claude_proposed_widenings.name: activated_ability_ongoing_operations
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's activated property creates a temporary weapon rider that persists after activation and resolves later on a weapon hit. Current non-spell activation mechanics support immediate phases plus an optional duration, but they cannot carry ongoing trigger/effect operations during that duration.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: weapon_hit_consumes_stored_rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The coating is consumed by the first hit made with this specific weapon, then resolves a save gate on the struck creature. The current surface has no honest way to bind an activated temporary rider to a specific item, spend it on first qualifying hit, and branch into save/damage/condition on that hit target.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.
